report_name: Microsoft Warns of Phishing Campaign Impersonating M365 Notifications

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: The campaign used emails with malicious links disguised as a 'RESTORE MESSAGES' button, which led to a credential harvesting page.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: A large-scale, coordinated phishing campaign targeted Microsoft 365 users with emails mimicking official Microsoft service health notifications, using social engineering to create a false sense of urgency.

campaigns.name: Microsoft 365 Service Outage Phishing Campaign
campaigns.description: A high-volume credential phishing campaign detected on November 13, 2026, that impersonates legitimate Microsoft 365 service health notifications to steal user credentials for subsequent attacks like business email compromise (BEC).

identities.name: Microsoft 365 Users
identities.description: Users of Microsoft 365 worldwide who were targeted by a phishing campaign impersonating service health notifications.

infrastructure.name: Phishing Sender Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A variety of non-Microsoft domains used to send the phishing emails, including moments-notice.com, planetmaison.com, and newbooker.com.

infrastructure.name: Phishing Redirector Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Redirector domain reallifeaccounting.com used in the malicious links to forward users to the final credential harvesting page.

indicators.name: M365 Phishing Campaign Domains
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: M365 Phishing Campaign DNS Query
id: d3a0b1c2-e4f5-4a9b-8cde-f0123456789a
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with a Microsoft 365 credential phishing campaign observed in November 2026.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/11/16/high-volume-phishing-campaign-uses-microsoft-365-outage-lures-target-multiple-industry-sectors-2/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-17
tags:
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName:
      - 'moments-notice.com'
      - 'planetmaison.com'
      - 'newbooker.com'
      - 'reallifeaccounting.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to domains used in a Microsoft 365 phishing campaign.

indicators.name: M365 Phishing Email Body Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: M365 Phishing Email Body Content
id: a9b8c7d6-e5f4-4a3b-8c2d-e1f09876543b
status: experimental
description: Detects email body content consistent with a Microsoft 365 credential phishing campaign that uses service outage lures.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/11/16/high-volume-phishing-campaign-uses-microsoft-365-outage-lures-target-multiple-industry-sectors-2/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-17
tags:
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection:
    Body|contains|all:
      - 'messages have been held'
      - 'will be deleted within 24 hours'
      - 'RESTORE MESSAGES'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects specific phrases in email bodies associated with the M365 outage lure phishing campaign.
